title: Marketing Advisor
description: Provides leadership oversight and direction for public relations, public affairs, marketing and social media. Works closely with the Administrative, Executive and Advisory Boards and Primary Handlers, and reports to the Chief Information Officer.

title: Training Lead
description: Oversees the training goals of our service dogs in training, and the management and growth of the Training Advisors.

title: Training Advisor
description: Oversees the day-to-day activities of an assigned dog team, working with the Team Lead, Primary Handler and secondary handlers to keep the dog on track to graduate.

title: Disability Advocacy and Education Advisor
description: Continuously implements and improves accessibility, accommodations and educational materials across our operations, and supports campus leadership.

title: Puppy Raiser Coordinator
description: Oversees operations, logistics, recruitment, onboarding and ongoing support for the Puppy Raiser Program.
